Event date: CMH ETO-OB assignment table entry dated 19 August 1944 (division passes to VIII Corps). Location: the coordinate is the CP at Plouguin listed by CMH three days later (22 August); the division position on 19 August is not stated. Breakout-30 says the 29th Division assembled just south of Lannilis four days after 19 August (23 August), about 9 km from Plouguin. Plouguin is kept as a low-confidence point; the attachment to VIII Corps is supported separately by the CMH table. Relationship: the CMH table does not distinguish assigned from attached.

current_activity: attacking Brest on the right of the VIII Corps line
notes: Breakout-30 p641: 29th Division on the right, 8th Division in the center (main effort), 2nd Division on the left; attack set for the afternoon of 25 August.
